fixtureNotes: Profiles 0/25/1001 label row dimensions; guide and quote rows capped at the existing 100-item write maximum, chemicals at 50 and visit photos at 24. Work movements, saved monthly pool blocks, invoice lines and eligible extras reach 1001; these are tested dimensions, not application maxima.

Minimum extras PDF uses one eligible line because an empty billing scope returns 404. Minimum quote uses legacy nullable estimate values and confirms explicit review text. Other minimum fixtures use zero rows where accepted.

Insurance notes contain exactly 2000 characters, quote terms 3000 and large item/quote descriptions 300. Newline-containing insurance fixture exercises two physical pages. The initial single-paragraph fixture was adjusted after it did not force pagination; no application defect was inferred.
Fifty-six small synthetic 640x360 JPEG originals, with up to 24 per visit, are hashed before/after read and removed. This covers photo count and layout, not 25 MiB/64 MiB input byte boundaries.

Guide stock totals and movements are separately seeded display sources; this PDF probe does not certify ledger reconciliation. Financial document totals use stored values, pending extras sum one-cent rows, and quote final amount is checked against the calculated snapshot.
Latin/Greek text remains readable; unsupported Han character uses the existing [U+6F22] marker. This is explicit fallback, not full-glyph or multilingual acceptance.
limits: RSS includes production routers, local HTTP client, fixture input and PDF text decoding in one new process per profile, not per PDF; excludes database/browser. Maximum sampled RSS across all reads 494.01 MiB. 30 s/64 MiB/768 MiB remain QA guards, not VPS or device SLA.
Whole PDF buffers and all pages are held in memory. Maximum saved output is 308620 bytes/170 pages; larger text, images or simultaneous exports are not certified.
No commands, external fetches or deliveries were submitted by the volume probe. Permission and immutable-source checks do not certify upload writes.
Geometry validates text rectangles only; it is not a complete image-collision, semantic layout or screen-reader audit. Thirteen rendered pages reviewed manually across all nine families.
New fixtures completely removed; old regression fixtures exist only in the isolated discarded QA database.

C04-F remains in progress for eight upload surfaces. Listed multer values are configured caps, not evidence of HTTP inclusivity or correctly handled over-limit errors. Arbitrary attachment types remain allowed where the product contract allows them; do not invent a type whitelist.
Administrative 500 MiB system-update archive excluded: it is a deployment surface, not an operational attachment. No upgrade command executed.
